factProposals.value: The Command Center is a static, dependency-free page (vanilla JS ES modules, no framework, no CDN) that fetches .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json at runtime — chosen because it has to run as a plain GitHub Pages site with no server and no place to hold a secret.

The Knowledge base tab's "chat panel" is implemented as local keyword search over the already-loaded plan/progress JSON, not a hosted LLM call — a static page cannot hold an API key, so it says plainly when it can't answer rather than guessing.

plan.agents[] is empty — this project's plan does not yet define a scoped AI agent roster (triggers, autonomy levels, approval gates). The AI agents tab is built from story ownership (owner_agent) instead, and says so rather than presenting an owner as an agent.

decisions.statement: Sample mode reuses the real plan.json (actual requirements and stories) and only substitutes a synthetic progress.json/manifest.json, rather than inventing a parallel fictional project.
decisions.rationale: Shows a believable further-along state without fabricating requirements, customers, or integrations that don't exist.

limitations.statement: REQ-013 (Microsoft SQL Server), REQ-014 (Anthropic API) and REQ-015 (typed FastAPI/Pydantic API) all show fulfilled_by: [] in .colaberry/plan.json — the traceability view renders this as a real gap rather than hiding it. Note: REQ-015 in particular already has working backend code (backend/app/main.py, a real FastAPI app with Pydantic response models, per this repo's own PROGRESS.md) that the plan's fulfilled_by list does not reflect — worth reconciling the plan against the built backend.
